title: FATHER GOD, REPLACE MY STRUGGLES WITH YOUR VICTORY
text: If this word ministers to your spirit this morning, I want you to share it with somebody. There's someone in your circle, there's someone in your family, there's someone in your workplace that needs to hear what the spirit of God is saying in this hour. Don't keep this to yourself. The Bible says in Psalm 107, "Let the redeemed of the Lord say so." When God does something, when God speaks something, when God shows you something, you have a responsibility to become a voice. So share this with someone who needs a touch from heaven this morning. I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are right now. Whether you are in your room, whether you're in your car, whether you're at your place of business, I want you to understand that this is not just another prayer session. This is a prophetic intercession. This is a divine moment where heaven is ready to interfere with the natural order of your life. The Bible says there is a time and a season for every purpose under heaven. And I decree that this is your season of divine replacement. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before your throne of grace this morning. We come not in our own righteousness, but in the righteousness of our Lord Jesus Christ. We come not by our merit, but by your mercy. We come not by our qualification, but by the blood that was shed on Calvary. And Father, we ask that as we engage heaven this morning, let there be a sovereign move of your spirit. Let the angels of God be dispatched. Let demonic resistance be paralyzed. Let every satanic embgo be cancelled in the mighty name of Jesus. You see, beloved, I want you to understand something this morning. The title of this ministration is not just a nice statement. Father, replace my struggle with your victory. Is a prophetic declaration. It is a legal petition before the court of heaven. It is an invocation of covenant promises. And I want you to know that God specializes in replacement. God is a God of exchange. God is a God of substitution. Where there has been pain, God brings healing. Where there has been lack, God brings abundance. Where there has been defeat, God brings victory. The scripture is replete with examples of divine replacement. When Abraham was struggling with the sacrifice of his son Isaac on Mount Moriah, Genesis 22 tells us that God provided a ram in the thicket. That was divine replacement. When the children of Israel were struggling in Egyptian bondage for 430 years, God raised up a deliverer called Moses and their struggle was replaced with victory. When David was struggling with a giant called Golth, God replaced his struggle with a testimony that is still being preached today. When the three Hebrew boys were struggling in the fiery furnace, God replaced their struggle with a promotion. When Daniel was struggling in the lion's den, God replaced his struggle with elevation. So this morning, I stand in the office of a prophet and I decree over your life, your season of struggling is over. Your season of barely making it is terminated. Your season of going round and round the same mountain has come to an end. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes chapter 3, to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under heaven. I prophesy that your season has changed. Your time has come. Your hour has arrived. Father, I pray for everyone hearing this word right now. from the rising of the sun to the going down of the same. Every battle that has overstayed its welcome in their life, I command it to expire by fire. Every problem that has become a family inheritance, I command generational causes to be broken in the name of Jesus. Every struggle that has lasted longer than it should, I decrease supernatural intervention. Let the God of suddenly visit your situation. Let the God of in a moment show up in your circumstances. Let the God of speedily arise and scatter every confederation of darkness that has made your life a battlefield. The Bible says in Isaiah 43:1 19, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." God is saying to someone this morning, I am about to do a new thing in your life. The old patterns are breaking. The old cycles are ending. The old limitations are being removed. God is making a way where there has been no way. God is creating an opening where there has been closure. God is establishing a path where there has been blockage. Now, I want you to pray with me. Open your mouth and say, "Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive divine replacement. Every area of my life where struggle has dominated, I call forth victory. Every dimension of my existence, where failure has been recurrent, I summon breakthrough. Every sector of my world where defeat has been consistent, I command triumph. Let your power replace my weakness. Let your wisdom replace my ignorance. Let your favor replace my rejection. Let your abundance replace my lack. Let your health replace my sickness. Let your joy replace my sorrow in the mighty name of Jesus. You see beloved, one of the things you must understand is that struggle is not God's design for your life. Struggle is a consequence of the fall. When Adam and Eve sinned in the Garden of Eden, struggle entered into the human experience. Genesis 3:1 17 to 19, God said to Adam, "Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten of the tree of which I commanded you, saying, you shall not eat of it. Cursed is the ground for your sake. In toil you shall eat of it all the days of your life. both thorns and thistles it shall bring forth for you, and you shall eat the herb of the field. In the sweat of your face, you shall eat bread till you return to the ground. But I have good news for you this morning. Jesus Christ came to reverse the curse. Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, cost is everyone who hangs on a tree." When Jesus died on the cross, he took upon himself every cause that was meant for you. He carried every struggle that was assigned to your bloodline. He bore every hardship that was programmed into your destiny. And on the third day, when he rose from the dead, he rose with victory. He rose with triumph. He rose with dominion. So this morning, I want you to appropriate that victory. I want you to lay claim to that triumph. I want you to take possession of that dominion. The Bible says in Romans 8:37, "In all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us." You are not just a survivor, you are more than a conqueror. You are not just managing, you are dominating. You are not just existing, you are prevailing. Father, I pray for every man, every woman, every young person that is hearing this word. Where the enemy has set up a stronghold of struggle in their finances, I command that stronghold to be demolished by the power of the Holy Ghost. Where the devil has established a pattern of struggle in their health, I decree divine reversal. Where Satan has programmed a cycle of struggle in their relationships, I prophesy divine realignment. Let every structure of struggle collapse like the walls of Jericho. Let every foundation of hardship be uprooted like the tree that Jesus cursed. Let every system of difficulty be dismantled by the finger of God. Now I want to show you something from the scriptures. In the book of Exodus chapter 14, the children of Israel found themselves in a place of terrible struggle. Behind them was Pharaoh and his army. Before them was the Red Sea. To their left and to their right were mountains. They were trapped. They were cornered. They were surrounded. And the Bible says in verse 10, "And when Pharaoh drew near, the children of Israel lifted their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians marched after them." So they were very afraid. And the children of Israel cried out to the Lord. But look at what Moses said to them in verse 13 and 14. He said, "Do not be afraid. Stand still and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will accomplish for you today. For the Egyptians whom you see today, you shall see again no more forever. The Lord will fight for you and you shall hold your peace. This is a prophetic word for somebody this morning. The struggle you are seeing today, you will not see it anymore. The battle you are fighting today is the last time you will fight it. The problem you are dealing with today, it will not follow you into your tomorrow. And then God gave Moses an instruction in verse 15 and 16. He said, "Why do you cry to me? Tell the children of Israel to go forward, but lift up your rod and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. And the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea. God was saying the path to your victory is through the very thing that looks like your impossibility. The Red Sea that looked like their limitation became their liberation. The water that appeared to be their prison became their pathway. The obstacle that seemed to be their obstruction became their opportunity. I prophesy to someone this morning. What looks like your red sea is about to become your miracle. What appears to be your dead end is about to become your divine opening. What seems to be your impossibility is about to become your testimony. God is about to turn your struggle into your strength. God is about to convert your test into your testimony. God is about to transform your mess into your message. Lift your voice and pray. Father, every red sea situation in my life, I command it to part by fire. Every impossible circumstance that has held me bound, I decree divine intervention. Every hopeless condition that has kept me stagnant, I prophesy supernatural turnaround. Let the rod of Moses wave over my situation. Let the power that divided the Red Sea divide every obstacle in my path. Let the God who made a way in the sea make a way in my life in Jesus mighty name. You see there are dimensions to struggle that many believers do not understand. There is natural struggle and there is spiritual struggle. Natural struggle is when you are dealing with the normal challenges of life. the pressure of paying bills, the stress of maintaining relationships, the difficulties of building a career, but spiritual struggle is when there is a demonic agenda behind your difficulties. It is when there is a satanic conspiracy against your progress. It is when there are witchcraft manipulations affecting your destiny. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this age, against spiritual host of wickedness in the heavenly places." Paul is revealing to us that there is a dimension of struggle that is not physical, it is spiritual. It is not what you can see. It is what you cannot see. It is not what is happening in the natural. It is what is happening in the spirit realm. And this is why many people struggle despite their education. They struggle despite their hard work. They struggle despite their talent. They struggle despite their connections because there is a spiritual dimension to their struggle. There is a demonic hand in their hardship. There is a satanic agenda in their adversity. And until you address the spiritual root, the natural fruit will continue to manifest. This morning, I stand in the authority that Jesus gave to the church and I bind every principality that has been assigned to make you struggle. I paralyze every power that has been commissioned to frustrate your efforts. I render impotent every ruler of darkness that has been deployed to limit your advancement. I dismantle every spiritual host of wickedness that has been organized against your breakthrough in the name of Jesus. I command the spirit of struggle to release you now. I command the demon of hardship to take its hands off your life now. I command the agent of difficulty to let you go now. And I decree over you from this day forward, you will not struggle for what God has destined for you. Your labor will not be in vain. Your efforts will not be fruitless. Your work will not be counterproductive. Isaiah 65-23 says, "They shall not labor in vain, nor bring forth children for trouble, for they shall be the descendants of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them. I prophesy that you are a descendant of the blessed of the Lord. Therefore, struggle cannot be your portion. Hardship cannot be your testimony. Difficulty cannot be your story. Father, I pray that you will baptize every person hearing this word with the spirit of victory. Let the same spirit that raised Jesus from the dead quicken their mortal bodies. Let the same power that brought Jesus out of the grave bring them out of every pit of struggle. Let the same glory that clothed Jesus in resurrection clothe them in triumph. I decree that from today they will walk in victory. They will live in victory. They will walk in victory. They will do business in victory. They will minister in victory. They will parent in victory. They will marry in victory. Let victory become their identity in the name of Jesus. Now I want to take you to the book of Judges chapter 6. There was a man called Gideon. And the Bible says in verse one, "Then the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord. So the Lord delivered them into the hand of Midian for seven years. Verse two says, "And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel." Because of the Medidianites, the children of Israel made for themselves the dens, the caves, and the strongholds which are in the mountains. This was a picture of terrible struggle. The Medidianites would come and destroy their crops. They would take their livestock. They would impoverish the land. The Israelites were living in caves and dens like animals. They were hiding in fear. They were struggling just to survive. And in verse 6, the Bible says, "So Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Medidianites. And the children of Israel cried out to the Lord." Now watch what happened in verse 11 to 14. The Bible says, "Now the angel of the Lord came and sat under the terabent tree which was in Ofra, which belonged to Joash the Abzarite, while his son Gideon threshed wheat in the wine press, in order to hide it from the Medidionites." And the angel of the Lord appeared to him and said to him, "The Lord is with you, you mighty man of valor." Hideon said to him, "Oh my Lord, if the Lord is with us, why then has all this happened to us?" And where are all his miracles which our fathers told us about? Saying, did not the Lord bring us up from Egypt? But now the Lord has forsaken us and delivered us into the hands of the Medidionites. Then the Lord turned to him and said, "Go in this might of yours, and you shall save Israel from the hand of the Midianites. Have I not sent you?" I want you to see something powerful here. God called Gideon a mighty man of valor while he was still tresing wheat in a wine press. He called him a warrior while he was still hiding in fear. He called him a deliverer while he was still struggling with his own limitations. God was giving him a prophetic identity. God was declaring over him what he was about to become. God was replacing his struggle with his victory before the victory even manifested. And this is what I'm doing for you this morning in the realm of the spirit. I am calling you victorious while you may still be in the midst of battle. I am calling you prosperous while you may still be dealing with lack. I am calling you healed while you may still be experiencing symptoms. I am calling you delivered while you may still be feeling the pressure. Because God does not call things as they are. God calls those things that be not as though they were. Romans 4:17 says, "God who gives life to the dead and calls those things which do not exist as though they did." So right now I prophesy over your life. You are victorious. You are prosperous. You are healed. You are delivered. You are blessed. You are favored. You are elevated. You are promoted. You are enlarged. You are established. I don't care what your current situation looks like. I don't care what your bank account says. I don't care what the medical report says. I don't care what people are saying. I am speaking from the realm of the spirit and I am decreeing over you what God has already written in your book of destiny. Father, I pray that you will give everyone hearing this word the eyes of the spirit to see what you are doing in their life. Remove the veil of natural understanding. Remove the blindness of carnal reasoning. Remove the limitation of human wisdom. open their spiritual eyes to see that you are already working on their behalf. Let them see angels being dispatched. Let them see doors being open. Let them see provisions being released. Let them see breakthroughs being processed. Let them see victories being prepared in the mighty name of Jesus. You know, one of the reasons why people continue in struggle is because they have not yet discovered the power of prophetic declaration. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit." Your tongue is a creative instrument. Your words have creative power. What you say has the ability to shape your reality. When you continually speak struggle, you empower struggle. When you continually confess defeat, you authorize defeat. When you continually declare limitation, you establish limitation. But when you begin to speak in alignment with the word of God, when you begin to declare what God says about you, when you begin to prophesy your future, something shifts in the realm of the spirit. Job 22:28 says, "You will also declare a thing and it will be established for you." So light will shine on your ways. This is not positive thinking. This is not motivational speaking. This is spiritual warfare. This is prophetic declaration. This is kingdom legislation. So I want you to open your mouth right now and begin to speak victory over your life. Say, "I am victorious in my finances. I am victorious in my health. I am victorious in my marriage. I am victorious in my business. I am victorious in my career. I am victorious in my ministry. I am victorious in my family. Every area of my life that has been marked by struggle, I now mark it with victory. Every sector of my world that has been characterized by defeat, I now characterize it with triumph. Every dimension of my existence that has been defined by failure, I now define it with success in Jesus name. Now the Bible gives us insight into how God replaces struggle with victory. In the book of 2 Chronicles chapter 20, there was a king called Jehoshaphat. And verse 1 and two says, "It happened after this that the people of Moab, with the people of Ammon, and others with them besides the Ammonites came to battle against Jehoshaphat. Then some came and told Jehoshaphat, saying, "A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea, from Syria, and they are in Hazon Tama, which is Enedi." Jehoshaphat was facing a great struggle. A vast army was coming against him. Multiple nations had confederated to destroy his kingdom. He was outnumbered. He was outmatched. He was overwhelmed. And verse three says, "And Jehoshaphat feared and set himself to seek the Lord and proclaimed the fast throughout all Judah." This is the first key to replacing struggle with victory. Seek the Lord. When you are facing overwhelming circumstances, your first response should not be panic. Your first response should not be anxiety. Your first response should be to seek the face of God. The Bible says in verse 12, "Oh our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power against this great multitude that is coming against us, nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are upon you." Jehoshaphat was honest with God. He said we don't have the power. We don't have the strategy. We don't have the solution. But our eyes are upon you. This is the posture of faith. This is the attitude of dependence. This is the position of surrender. And look at what God said in verse 15 to 17. Thus says the Lord to you, do not be afraid, not dismayed because of this great multitude. For the battle is not yours, but God's tomorrow. Go down against them. They will surely come up by the ascent of Ze and you will find them at the end of the brook before the wilderness of Jerel. You will not need to fight in this battle. Position yourselves, stand still and see the salvation of the Lord who is with you, oh Judah, Jerusalem. Do not fear or be dismayed. Tomorrow go out against them for the Lord is with you. God was saying, "This is not your battle. This is my battle. I will fight for you. You just position yourself, stand still and watch me walk. And verse 22 says, "Now when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushes against the people of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Sea, who had come against Judah, and they were defeated." While they were praising, God was fighting. While they were worshiping, God was waring. While they were singing, God was scattering. I prophesy to you this morning, the battle you are fighting is not your battle. It is God's battle. And as you praise him, he will fight for you. As you worship him, he will war on your behalf. As you magnify him, he will scatter your enemies. So lift your voice right now and begin to praise the Lord. Begin to worship him. Begin to magnify his name. Don't wait until the victory manifests. Praise him in the midst of the battle. Worship him in the face of the struggle. Magnify him in the presence of the enemy. Father, I thank you because you are the Lord mighty in battle. You are the man of war. You are the captain of the host. You are the commander of angel armies. And I release your waring angels right now to fight on behalf of everyone hearing this word. Let the angels of the Lord go before them and prepare the way. Let the angels of the Lord go behind them and protect their backs. Let the angels of the Lord stand at their right hand and at their left hand. Let the angels of the Lord encamp around them and deliver them from every evil. I decree that they will not fight alone. Heaven will fight with them. Angels will fight for them. The spirit of God will fight through them and victory shall be their testimony in the name of Jesus. You see, there is something you must understand about the nature of spiritual warfare. The enemy does not give up easily. The devil does not surrender quickly. The forces of darkness do not retreat willingly. When you begin to pursue your victory, when you start to press toward your breakthrough, when you commence your journey toward your destiny, there will be resistance. There will be opposition. There will be confrontation. But the Bible says in James 4:7, "Therefore, submit to God. Resist the devil and he will flee from you." Notice the sequence. First, submit to God. then resist the devil. You cannot resist the devil in your own strength. You cannot confront demonic powers in your own ability. You cannot overcome spiritual wickedness in your own wisdom. You must first submit to God. You must surrender to his authority. You must align with his word. You must position yourself under his covering. And then from that place of submission, you resist the devil and he will flee. So this morning I want you to make a quality decision. I want you to take a definite stand. I want you to draw a line in the sand. Say, "Devil, I am done with your harassment. I am finished with your intimidation. I am through with your manipulation. I resist you in the name of Jesus. I refuse your agenda for my life. I reject your plans for my destiny. I renounce your claims over my family. You have no authority over me. You have no power over my children. You have no jurisdiction over my future. I am covered by the blood of Jesus. I am sealed by the Holy Spirit. I am protected by the angels of God and I command you to flee from me now in the mighty name of Jesus. The Bible says in Luke 10:19, "Behold, I give you the authority to trample on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you." Jesus has already given you authority. He has already delegated power to you. He has already equipped you with weapons of warfare. 2 Corinthians 10:4 says, "For the weapons of our warfare, are not carnal, but mighty in God for pulling down strongholds. You are not defenseless. You are not powerless. You are not helpless. You have been armed with supernatural weapons. You have been endued with heavenly authority. You have been invested with divine power. So rise up this morning in the consciousness of who you are in Christ. Rise up in the awareness of what you carry in the spirit. Rise up in the revelation of the authority that has been given to you. You are not a victim. You are a victor. You are not a casualty. You are a conqueror. You are not a slave. You are a son. You are not a servant. You are a king. You are not defeated. You are triumphant. Father, I pray for a baptism of boldness to come upon everyone hearing this word. Remove every spirit of fear. Remove every spirit of timidity. Remove every spirit of intimidation. Let the spirit of power, of love, and of a sound mind rest upon them. Let them know that you have not given them a spirit of fear. Let them understand that greater is he that is in them than he that is in the world. Let them walk in the confidence of their identity in Christ. Let them operate in the assurance of their authority in the spirit. Let them function in the certainty of their victory in the kingdom in Jesus mighty name. Now I want you to understand something about the principle of replacement. When God replaces your struggle with victory, he's not just removing something negative. He's also installing something positive. He's not just taking away, he's also putting in. He's not just delivering you from, he's also bringing you into. The Bible says in Psalm 23, "The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. He makes me to lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside the still waters. He restores my soul." God makes you lie down in green pastures. That means he brings you into a place of abundance. He leads you beside still waters. That means he brings you into a place of peace. He restores your soul. That means he brings you into a place of wholeness. So when God replaces your struggle, he replaces it with his provision. He replaces it with his peace. He replaces it with his restoration. He replaces it with his blessing, he replaces it with his favor, he replaces it with his glory. I prophesy over your life right now. God is bringing you into green pastures. He's leading you beside still waters. He's restoring your soul. Where there has been baroness, God is bringing fruitfulness. Where there has been turbulence, God is bringing tranquility. Where there has been brokenness, God is bringing wholeness. Where there has been poverty, God is bringing prosperity. Where there has been sickness, God is bringing health. Where there has been sorrow, God is bringing joy. Say this with me. Father, I receive divine replacement. I receive green pastures. I receive still waters. I receive restoration. I receive abundance. I receive peace. I receive wholeness. I receive every good thing that you have prepared for me. Let my life reflect your goodness. Let my testimony declare your faithfulness. Let my breakthrough manifest your power in Jesus' name. There is a prophetic word that I must deliver to someone this morning. The Lord is saying to you, the season of struggle has refined you. It has matured you. It has prepared you. But now the season is changing. I am about to release you into a dimension of victory that you have never experienced before. I am about to open doors for you that no man can shut. I am about to connect you with people who will accelerate your destiny. I am about to position you in places where you will demonstrate my glory. Do not look back at what you have been through. Look forward to what I'm about to do. For I am doing a new thing. I am establishing a new order. I am releasing a new anointing. And in this new season, struggle will not dominate your narrative. Victory will be your testimony. Father, I release this prophetic word over the life of every person hearing this ministration. Let it take root in their spirit. Let it germinate in their soul. Let it produce fruit in their life. I decree that this is their season of divine replacement. This is their moment of supernatural exchange. This is their time of heavenly intervention. Let struggle give way to victory. Let hardship surrender to blessing. Let difficulty yield to breakthrough. I seal this word in the realm of the spirit and I command it to manifest in the natural realm in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. As we come to the close of this ministration, I want you to understand that what you do with this word will determine what happens in your life. The Bible says in Luke 8:18, "Therefore, take heed how you hear. For whoever has to him more will be given and whoever does not have even what he seems to have will be taken from him. How you hear is as important as what you hear. If you hear this word with faith, it will produce results. If you hear it with doubt, it will be ineffective. If you receive it with expectation, it will manifest. If you dismiss it with skepticism, it will remain dormant. So I challenge you this morning. Receive this word. Believe this word. Act on this word. Let it become the foundation of your confession. Let it become the substance of your declaration. Let it become the basis of your expectation. And watch as God begins to replace your struggle with his victory. Watch as he begins to turn your situation around. Watch as he begins to manifest his power in your life. Father, I commit everyone who has heard this word into your hands. I ask that you will watch over this word to perform it. Let it accomplish the purpose for which you have sent it. Let it prosper in the thing for which you have released it and let the testimony of your faithfulness be evident in their lives from this day forward. Let them walk in victory. Let them live in triumph. Let them operate in dominion. for you have called them to be more than conquerors through Christ Jesus our Lord. And so it shall be in Jesus mighty name. Amen and amen. Now I want you to seal this prayer by declaring my struggle ends today. My victory begins now in Jesus name. Amen.
